title.narrative: Gestin Territorial para el Logro de Resultados de la Agenda de Cambio Climtico
Land Management for the Achievement of Results of the Climate Change Agenda

description.narrative: El objetivo de este programa es apoyar al Gobierno de Mxico en la mejora de la gestin territorial para la reduccin de emisiones y vulnerabilidad ante el CC, mediante tres componentes: (i) Gestin Territorial en el Sector Vivienda; (ii) Gestin Territorial en el Sector Forestal; y (iii) Coordinacin Interinstitucional.

The objective of this program is to support the Government of Mexico in improving land management to reduce emissions and vulnerability to climate change through three components: (i) land management in the housing sector; (ii) land management in the forestry sector; and (iii) interagency coordination.
